title: Prepare non-destructive worktree cleanup and harvest inventory
description: Create a concrete next-action inventory for prunable worktrees, patch-equivalent branches, old superpowers/autoresearch branches, and branches requiring harvest, without deleting or pruning anything.
action: Write .workflow/codebase/action-logs/worktree-cleanup-inventory-2026-04-27.md containing four lists: safe-prune-candidates, inspect-before-prune, harvest-before-cleanup, and keep-for-now. Include exact branch/worktree names and the command that would be run later, but do not run prune/remove/delete commands.
implementation: Run git worktree prune --dry-run and capture output for documentation only.
Run git status --short in dirty non-main worktrees only if paths still exist.
Write the inventory file with exact recommended next command for each group.
